SELECT anon_1.cntrycode AS anon_1_cntrycode, count(*) AS numcust, sum(anon_1.c_acctbal) AS totacctbal 
FROM (SELECT substr(customer.c_phone, %(substr_1)s, %(substr_2)s) AS cntrycode, customer.c_acctbal AS c_acctbal 
FROM customer 
WHERE substr(customer.c_phone, %(substr_1)s, %(substr_2)s) IN (%(param_1_1)s, %(param_1_2)s, %(param_1_3)s, %(param_1_4)s, %(param_1_5)s, %(param_1_6)s, %(param_1_7)s) AND customer.c_acctbal > (SELECT avg(customer_1.c_acctbal) AS avg_1 
FROM customer AS customer_1 
WHERE customer_1.c_acctbal > %(c_acctbal_1)s AND substr(customer_1.c_phone, %(substr_3)s, %(substr_4)s) IN (%(param_2_1)s, %(param_2_2)s, %(param_2_3)s, %(param_2_4)s, %(param_2_5)s, %(param_2_6)s, %(param_2_7)s)) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey))) AS anon_1 GROUP BY anon_1.cntrycode ORDER BY anon_1.cntrycode

statements.sql:
SELECT cntrycode, COUNT(*) AS numcust, SUM(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) AS cntrycode, c_acctbal
      FROM customer
      WHERE SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) IN (:b0,:b1,:b2,:b3,:b4,:b5,:b6)
        AND c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) FROM customer
                         WHERE c_acctbal > 0.00
                           AND SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) IN (:b7,:b8,:b9,:b10,:b11,:b12,:b13))
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = c_custkey)
     ) AS custsale
GROUP BY cntrycode
ORDER BY cntrycode
